name: 03848 · Kingston, NH
findings: ZIP 03848 (Kingston) has 18 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.

33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
